PEEP optimization was achieved through a decremental PEEP test. Starting from 15 cmH2O, PEEP was reduced by 2 cmH2O increments every 2 min until reaching 5 cmH2O. At each PEEP level, end‐expiratory PL, oxygenation index, and respiratory system compliance (Crs) were documented. The optimal PEEP was identified as the level maintaining end‐expiratory PL between 0 and 2 cmH2O with the highest Crs.

The EPM‐guided group had shorter mechanical ventilation duration [(12.32 ± 3.24) versus. (16.83 ± 4.52) d, p = 0.013] and ICU length of stay [(18.53 ± 4.62) versus. (23.72 ± 5.83) d, p = 0.018] compared to the conventional group, along with a lower VAP incidence (14.52% vs. 25.81% and p = 0.038) and a 28‐day mortality rate (19.35% vs. 32.26% and p = 0.042).

Eligible patients were screened within 48 h of mechanical ventilation and randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to either the EPM‐guided group or the conventional group using computer‐generated randomization.

sample_size_calculation.value: Sample size calculation was performed using the G*Power 3.1 software. recruitment_manoeuvre_detail.value: Lung recruitment maneuvers were performed when severe hypoxemia (PaO2/FiO2 ratio < 150 mmHg) or atelectasis (indicated by significant Crs decrease) occurred. The recruitment process involved a stepwise increase in PEEP to 30–40 cmH2O for 30–40 s, with continuous hemodynamic monitoring. Postrecruitment PEEP was set to the previously determined optimal level.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all patients met 2012 Berlin ARDS criteria with SAP cause. obesity_subgroup: mean BMI ~24.8 kg/m2, no obesity requirement. timing_subgroup: intervention begins at enrolment (screened within 48 h of mechanical ventilation); per codebook ruling, enrolment-referenced timing carries no information about earliness in illness, so coded unclear. ptp_target_subgroups: end-expiratory PL target 0–2 cmH2O via absolute Pes subtraction (PL = Paw − Pes); end-inspiratory PL limit 20 cmH2O also applied but the enum's absolute_positive_end_expiratory_ptp captures the PEEP titration target.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap with any COHORTS.md cluster. Single centre (Affiliated Anqing First People's Hospital of Anhui Medical University, Anqing, China), enrolment January–December 2023, ethics approval AFky2023010322, no trial registration number reported. None of the listed clusters (epvent1, epvent2, mannheim_boesing, mgh_lung_rescue, angers) involve a Chinese single-centre SAP-ARDS population; enrolment window postdates publication of talmor_2008, beitler_2019, fumagalli_2019, pirrone_2016, and boesing_2022.
unclear_items: citation.trial_registration: no trial registration number reported anywhere in the paper.
design.randomised: stated as randomized controlled trial with computer-generated randomization; no registration to verify.

comparator.comparator_types: the common initial protocol states 'Initial positive end‐expiratory pressure (PEEP) and FiO2 were adjusted according to the ARDSNet low PEEP/high FiO2 table' for both groups, while the conventional group protocol states 'PEEP and FiO2 adjustments followed the ARDSNet high PEEP/FiO2 table'; coded the conventional arm as ardsnet_high_peep_fio2_table per its dedicated protocol section, but the initial-phase low-PEEP table applies to both arms.
population.bmi: reported per arm in Table 1 only; cohort-level bmi left null rather than pooled.

feasibility.complications_explicitly_none: Table 7 records general complications (stress ulcer, arrhythmia, AKI, thrombosis) but the paper makes no statement about balloon-related complications specifically; left null.
outcomes: 12 h timepoint is mentioned in Methods ('baseline, 12, 24, 48, and 72 h') but no 12 h data appear in any table; 12 h data appear unreported.
intervention.timing: reference event is enrolment (screened within 48 h of mechanical ventilation), so timing_subgroup is unclear per codebook ruling.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Internal consistency concerns: several t values are identical across different rows/tables (e.g. t = 7.124 for both End‐inspiratory PL 72 h and Pplat 72 h; t = 0.432 for both BMI and VT baseline), and the abstract reports 'intensive care nit (ICU)' typo. The between-group difference in PaO2/FiO2 at 72 h is quoted as '73.41 ± 12.42 mmHg' in text, which matches 268.82 − 195.41 = 73.41. Fluid balance Day 1 (379 vs 542) equals cumulative 24 h row. No balloon placement success/failure or complication data specific to the catheter are reported. The multivariate model includes ΔPL (an post-treatment measurement) as a predictor of 28-day mortality, which the authors themselves acknowledge as a methodological caveat.
